selection: First four prespecified development seeds, all five methods, before new branch outcomes. Exploratory four-family diagnosis, not a final comparison or powered method ranking.

arms.a_nominal: Replay saved no-correction nominal relative commands; verify complete physical trace against original nominal-policy run.
arms.b_first_fixed: Replay nominal relative commands except the first originally selected active eight-action chunk, then use the saved nominal future commands. Counterfactual offline diagnostic only.
arms.c_first_replan: Identical execution through first selected active chunk, then frozen policy on own two-frame observations, no further correction. Same per-call noise seeds and eight-action timing.
arms.d_repeated: Previously audited full repeated-correction policy run, reused unchanged.

comparisons: A-B residual effect under fixed subsequent relative commands; B-C subsequent policy reaction; C-D additional correction regime including subsequent reaction interactions. Differences are not additive independent causal contributions.
metrics: Same full300action global100Hz position2px/rotation2deg and10Hz coverage-loss0.02, executedpusherjerk, first violation, end object velocities, checkpoint errors at firstchunkend, +8,+16 and episodeend. Task success separate.
scope: First correction taken from existing causal selection, never selected by new physical outcome. Fixed nominal future commands only supplied to offline B diagnostic; not a deployable policy. No model/recalibration updates. No actuation delay injection.
scheduling: CPU open-loop replay first; GPU replanning begins only after locked PushT runtime_strong.done to avoid adding workload during timing.
